name: financials_analyze_financial_transactions
description:
Analyzes Amazon SP-API financial transactions using the same current-generation ClickHouse fact source as Profit Analytics. Results apply transaction restatements and deletions and support optional day, week, month, quarter, or year breakouts.

For report parity, pass dates as query.filters.start_date and query.filters.end_date; both bounds are inclusive marketplace-local calendar dates. Scope a single-marketplace report with query.filters.marketplaces or marketplace_codes. Country aliases such as US resolve to the exact Amazon marketplace (Amazon.com and its marketplace ID) and do not include Non-Amazon/MCF activity.

Rows are grouped by summary class, summary subclass, currency, and optional period. Never add local net_amount values across currencies. For multi-currency analysis, set query.filters.consolidation_currency and use net_amount_consolidated; report any fx_missing_lines.

BOOKKEEPING METHOD: this is the accrual-method source, recognized on posted date. Statement tools remain the cash-method source.

query.description: Query envelope for financial transactions reconciliation analysis.

filters.description: Filters for the query. company_id is required; report_months is strongly recommended for reconciliation.

report_months.description: Monthly partitions to include, YYYY-MM, in the MARKETPLACE-LOCAL report timezone (US/CA=Pacific, UK=London, EU=CET, JP=Tokyo, AU=Sydney). Use one value for a monthly report, e.g. ['2026-03']. Matches Amazon's monthly summary period.

marketplaces.description: Optional exact report marketplace filter. Accepts a country code (for example 'US'), marketplace name ('Amazon.com'), or marketplace ID ('ATVPDKIKX0DER'). A country alias includes only that Amazon marketplace, never its Non-Amazon/MCF counterpart.

marketplace_codes.description: Alias for query.filters.marketplaces with the same exact-marketplace semantics.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive start date (YYYY-MM-DD) on the marketplace-local posted day. Must be nested under query.filters.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end date (YYYY-MM-DD) on the marketplace-local posted day. Must be nested under query.filters.

consolidation_currency.description: Optional 3-letter ISO currency. Converts each line using staging.currency_rates for its posted day; use net_amount_consolidated across currencies and report any fx_missing_lines.

summary_classes.description: Optional filter by summary class: Income, Expenses, Tax, Transfers. Case-insensitive exact match.

summary_subclasses.description: Optional substring filter by summary subclass, e.g. 'FBA transaction fees' or 'Product sales'. Case-insensitive.

field.description: Column to sort by. Default preserves the payment summary report order.

periodicity.description: Time-series aggregation. Default 'none' returns one row per (summary_class, summary_subclass, currency) - the classic report shape, period=null. Any other value ALSO breaks results out into time buckets over the MARKETPLACE-LOCAL posted day (posted_date_day): 'day' = calendar day, 'week' = ISO week (Monday start), 'month' = calendar month, 'quarter', 'year'. Each output row then also carries a 'period' date (the bucket start, YYYY-MM-DD). Use this for daily/weekly sales dynamics, e.g. periodicity='day' with a start_date/end_date range. NOTE: buckets multiply the row count (periods x subclasses x currencies) - raise 'limit' accordingly (max 500) and narrow the date range or summary_classes/summary_subclasses if results are truncated.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (default 200, max 500). When periodicity is set, rows = periods x subclasses x currencies, so raise this or narrow the filters to avoid truncation.

period.description: Time bucket start (YYYY-MM-DD) in the marketplace-local calendar, present when periodicity != 'none' ('day' = that day, 'week' = the Monday, 'month'/'quarter'/'year' = the first day of the bucket). Null when periodicity='none'. Rows are grouped per (period, summary_class, summary_subclass, currency).

class_order.description: Display order of the top-level summary class.

subclass_order.description: Display order within the summary class.

summary_class.description: Summary class: Income, Expenses, Tax, or Transfers.

currency.description: Local (marketplace) currency of this row. Rows are grouped per currency - NEVER sum debits/credits/net_amount across rows with different currency values.

debits.description: Sum of negative source amounts for this subclass, in the row's local currency.

credits.description: Sum of positive source amounts for this subclass, in the row's local currency.

net_amount.description: Net amount (debits + credits) in the row's LOCAL currency. Only comparable/summable within the same currency.

consolidation_currency.description: Echo of filters.consolidation_currency (null when not requested).

net_amount_consolidated.description: Net amount converted line-by-line to consolidation_currency at each line's posted-day FX rate. Safe to sum across ALL rows regardless of local currency. Null when consolidation_currency was not requested.

fx_missing_lines.description: Lines excluded from net_amount_consolidated because no FX rate existed for their currency/date. If > 0, the consolidated total is incomplete - tell the user.

line_count.description: Number of source rows contributing to this subclass.

examples.title: Reconcile a US monthly summary report
examples.description: Amazon summary reports are per-marketplace and in local currency, so scope to ONE marketplace. Totals come back in USD (Amazon.com's local currency) - compare directly against the report's Income/Expenses/Tax/Transfers lines.

examples.title: Reconcile a single-day report
examples.description: Day filters use the marketplace-local calendar (posted_date_day), matching Amazon's daily report window exactly.

examples.title: All marketplaces consolidated to one currency
examples.description: Multi-marketplace data mixes currencies (USD, CAD, EUR, ...). Pass consolidation_currency - the company's main currency from account_list_companies, or ask the user - and sum net_amount_consolidated across rows. Local figures stay per-currency in each row. Check fx_missing_lines = 0 before presenting the total as complete.

examples.title: Only fee lines for one marketplace
examples.description: Return only expense subclasses containing 'fee' in the label.
